verdict.rationale: jo's own docs describe AI-generated insights drawn from the user's connected data. These include briefings that cover GitHub activity and open Linear issues assigned to you, "what did I miss" channel summaries, and scheduled weekly plans and morning priorities. It also works overnight to read incoming items and prepare your morning, and helps with messages, schedules and follow-ups using your connected context. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of briefing and insight quality, in-depth documentation of how suggestions are generated beyond short marketing and llms.txt snippets.
